dedupe_keys.name: smart company building energy management monitoring data

description: Honda Research Institute Europe publishes monitoring data from a company building with electricity, heating, cooling, onsite solar, combined heat and power and weather measurements. Dryad describes six years of raw, corrected and regularized time series at one-minute, fifteen-minute and hourly steps. A separate issue collection records detection, harmonization and correction work; a reduced data package is also listed. The deposit is free under CC0. These observations can calibrate building-energy controls and test optimization or digital-twin models alongside model-energyplus. A caveat is that sensor corrections and derived measurements need attention before treating all columns as independent observations. The site represents one company building and cannot establish broader consumption patterns alone. Dryad lists a very large main archive; only metadata and the file manifest were inspected. Exact dates, meter counts and file-level completeness were not independently verified in the own dataset documentation.
